title: Space Mirrors: Are They Really a Threat?

scenes.text: Over 1,000 space mirrors could harm ecosystems!
Many believe space mirrors will only provide light.
scenes.label: Only provide light

scenes.text: In reality, they can alter ecosystems and climate.
scenes.label: Alter ecosystems and climate

scenes.text: Follow to feed your curious mind daily.

description: Space mirrors could have unintended environmental impacts, challenging the idea they only serve a beneficial purpose. Follow for daily science!
